question_text: Why do herbivores have a longer small intestine than carnivores?
question_intent: Explain cellulose digestion and intestine length.
student_answer_ocr: Cellulose takes a lot of time and effort to break down, so herbivores need a longer small intestine. Meat is easier to digest so carnivores have a shorter intestine.
missed_scheme_point: Correct idea may have been missed due to non-textbook phrasing.
